title: Full Ore Tools animated
description: Makes tools have the handle to be like the ore they are made from instead of it being made from stick
body:
This resource pack makes the handle of tools seem to be made from ore instead of sticks, this does not change copper tools currently, it is also animated too and there is a version without the animations too in case you dont want it

This was inspired by reimagined spears and animated items, there is also an version [without animations](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/full-ore-tools)

![Full ore tools](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6a7e35f5900604a7223fea6af755c68950c126bc.png)
